name: claimcenter-runner
description: Self-contained Windows app for the Playwright Test Runner UI (SmartCOMM Validator and related tools)

scripts.build: npm run stage && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js && npm run copy-to-share
scripts.release: npm run stage && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js --publish=always && npm run copy-to-share
